thread:
maria: @sophie quick heads-up from the HelixHealth SI onboarding — their telemetry agent can't complete the TLS handshake with our ingest (we're seeing 403s). Need a short architecture triage + implementation escalation. Can we do this today?

arjun: saw the alert. can you paste the exact error? 403 usually implies auth or SNI mismatch.

lucy: fwiw I pulled the trailing logs from their dedicated pool — matching 403 + 'X-Auth-Provider' header missing. Also seeing TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) intermittently.

maria: error excerpt: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\nDate: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 13:02:11 GMT\nServer: redwood-ingest\nX-Error: missing-identity\n` — ingress host they hit is `ingest.eu.redwood.example.com`.

dave: we rotated the edge gateway certs last night. we didn't whitelist Redwood IPs yet. will open firewall for your ranges if you give me the list. also need the expected SNI value to verify on our side.

sophie: proposed plan: 1) quick 20m arch call to confirm SNI/CA + fallback, 2) SI pushes temporary agent config to use mTLS if customer can add our CA, 3) field runbook for fallback (batched S3 upload). I can join at 14:00 UTC today.

arjun: SI can prepare a patch to the agent: switch to mTLS and present client cert. will need the CA bundle and cert thumbprint from Redwood. can you share cert thumbprint and expected SNI?

maria: SNI = `ingest.redwood-eu`; cert thumbprint (sha256) = `ABC1:23DE:9F4A:...:E7C9`. IP CIDR to allow outbound: `10.2.1.0/24` (HelixHealth's NAT range) — but for clarity, Redwood's ingest egress IPs are `35.198.12.0/24` and `35.199.45.0/24`.

lucy: quick test curl (paste into customer VM to verify):
```
curl -v --resolve ingest.eu.redwood.example.com:443:35.198.12.45 \ 
  https://ingest.eu.redwood.example.com/telemetry/upload \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --cert /path/to/client.crt --key /path/to/client.key
```

lucy: runbook snippet for agent config (field copyable):
```
agent.conf:
telemetry:
  endpoint: https://ingest.eu.redwood.example.com/telemetry/upload
  tls:
    enable: true
    sni: ingest.redwood-eu
    ca_bundle_path: /etc/ssl/redwood/ca.pem
    client_cert: /etc/ssl/redwood/client.pem  # optional, for mTLS
```

dave: okay i'm adding 35.198.12.0/24 and 35.199.45.0/24 now, and will import your CA once you send it. 14:00 UTC works for us. please send calendar invite + checklist.

maria: will send invite and the preflight checklist (network ports, required certs, agent cfg diff) in 10m. thanks everyone — moving to action. :thumbsup:
